source: Inland Empire Utilities Agency official recycled-water quality report
title: RW & Effluent Water Quality (all years).xlsx / 2025 report
license: Official public utility report; reuse terms not separately specified
aggregation: Average, minimum and maximum values based on monthly averages; EC is based on 24-hour composite laboratory samples.
coverage: RP-1 provides pH, TDS, bicarbonate alkalinity, calcium, chloride, magnesium, sodium, sulfate and silica ranges; temperature is not reported.
extraction_note: RP-1 rows were transcribed from page 1 of the public PDF into RP1_2025_normalized.csv; no values were imputed or converted.
source_context: Direct recycled-water facility report; not a cooling-tower operating dataset and not an independent PHREEQC validation package.
